seo_meta.title: Roborock — Lidar-Mapped Robot Vacuums
seo_meta.description: Robot vacuums engineered for the messy weeks, not the showroom. Lidar mapping, anti-tangle brush, auto-washing dock. Free shipping in the US.

seo_meta.title: About Roborock — Engineered for the messy weeks
seo_meta.description: We measured every brush, mop, and lidar map so you don't have to. Read how Roborock got built — and why we still answer every support email ourselves.

seo_meta.title: Team & Founders — Roborock
seo_meta.description: Meet the engineers behind Roborock — ex-iRobot, ex-self-driving SLAM, and the head of customer who still answers the first 50 escalations a week.

seo_meta.title: Sustainability — Roborock
seo_meta.description: Repairable by design. 60% recycled aluminum. Battery take-back since 2022. Read the four pillars (and the metrics behind them).

seo_meta.title: Press & Awards — Roborock
seo_meta.description: What Wirecutter, The Verge, Tom's Guide, Engadget, and Good Housekeeping have said about Roborock — plus the awards that came with the reviews.

seo_meta.title: S-Series Pro — Lidar Robot + Auto-Mop Dock | Roborock
seo_meta.description: 10,000 Pa suction, lidar SLAM, auto-lifting mop, self-empty + self-wash dock. The set-and-forget robot for pet households. From $1,199.

seo_meta.title: E-Series Essential — Real Lidar Under $500 | Roborock
seo_meta.description: Lidar mapping that actually works, anti-tangle brush, optional auto-empty dock. The robot vacuum your apartment deserves. $449.

seo_meta.title: 6-Month Replenish Kit — Brush, Filter, Mop Pads | Roborock
seo_meta.description: One kit, six months. Subscribe & save 20%. Fits S-Series Pro and E-Series. $79.

seo_meta.title: Best Robot Vacuums for Pet Households | Roborock
seo_meta.description: Anti-tangle brush + auto-washing mop. Engineered for long-haired pets. Shop our pet-household lineup.

seo_meta.title: Compare Roborock models — side-by-side specs
seo_meta.description: Suction, battery, mapping, mop, dock — every spec line from S-Series Pro, E-Series Essential, and the Replenish Kit, side-by-side.

seo_meta.title: Help Center — Setup, Maps, Troubleshooting | Roborock
seo_meta.description: Setup guides, app troubleshooting, replacement parts. Reply to any email and we'll help.

seo_meta.title: Setup & Maintenance Videos | Roborock
seo_meta.description: Step-by-step video walkthroughs — first-time setup, dock cleaning, brush replacement, and the seven things that fix 90% of stuck-up reports.

seo_meta.title: Product Manuals (PDF) | Roborock
seo_meta.description: Download the full user manual for every Roborock model. Searchable PDFs, English only at MVP — translations on request.

seo_meta.title: Find replacement parts that fit your Roborock
seo_meta.description: Pick the model you own to see what fits. The 6-month Replenish Kit covers the wear parts for both robots — set it on subscription.

seo_meta.title: Contact us | Roborock
seo_meta.description: Email, DM, or send us a note. A human reads every message and replies within a business day.

seo_meta.title: Customer Reviews — Roborock
seo_meta.description: Every verified review across the Roborock catalog. Filter by product or star rating. Real owner experiences, not staged testimonials.

seo_meta.title: Roborock Blog — Tests, comparisons, fixes
seo_meta.description: Hands-on robot vacuum reviews, sub-$500 lidar comparisons, and the troubleshooting list our support team uses daily.
